speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; can you tell me exactly how old you are in hours or days, and when these symptoms first started?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Volvulus.

The presence of bilious vomiting in a six-hour-old newborn, combined with a family history of pyloric stenosis, is highly suggestive of this surgical emergency. I am ordering an upper gastrointestinal series to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Upper GI Series
